title: Luxury Condo | Walk to Broadway | Pool + Parking
description:
Experience elevated city living in this modern luxury retreat located in the heart of downtown Nashville. Designed with style and comfort in mind, this upscale one-bedroom space features sleek contemporary finishes, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an open-concept layout that fills the space with natural light.

The space
Amenities include:
· 1 Queen Bed
· 1 Queen Sofa Bed - Sleeps 2
· 1 FREE secured parking spot in garage
· Smart TV
· High-speed internet
· Resort-style pool
· Fire pit courtyard with BBQ grills 
· Sky Lounge with Pool Table 
· Fully stocked kitchen
· In unit washer and dryer with pods & sheets
· Keurig with complimentary K-Cups and Creamer
· Shampoo, conditioner, & body wash provided
· Linens and towels provided
· Complimentary robes

Just steps away from Nashville's top attractions:

Broadway – 8 min walk
Bridgestone Arena – 10 min walk
Nissan Stadium – 8 min drive
Country Music Hall of Fame – 8 min walk
Johnny Cash Museum – 15 min walk
Ryman Auditorium – 15 min walk
The Gulch (shopping & dining) – 15 min drive

Other things to note
When available early check in fee $40.00.
When available late check out fee $40.00.

Important House Notes:

• No parties or events allowed
• No smoking, vaping, or e-cigarettes inside
• Quiet hours are 10 PM – 7 AM
• Maximum of 4 guests
• Please respect the space and neighbors

Failure to follow house rules may result in additional fees.

*SMOKING FEE: $500
(Evidence of smoking during your stay will result in additional FEES)

*LOST key fob will result in a $300 fine.
